description:
Venture into an extraordinary test of movement as you explore vast realms with a unique twist. Engage in the art of lateral maneuvering, skillfully sidestepping through diverse landscapes without the ability to walk forward or backward. The Sideways Shuffle challenge immerses you in a new way of traversing, requiring strategic thinking and precision. Adapt your strategy, navigate treacherous terrain, and conquer formidable foes using the power of sidestepping. Embrace this unconventional journey and uncover the hidden rewards that await those who master the art of the Sideways Shuffle.

You have to strafe. The challenge is that you can only strafe to move.
name: Strafing Shuffle

rules.description: If you move forwards or backwards you will fail this challenge.
rules.name: Strafing Only
